title: Evaluating and Mitigating Anti-LGBTQ Biases in German and Multilingual Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30884v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. translated_title: 评估与缓解德语及多语言语言模型中的反LGBTQ偏见
translated_abstract: 尽管语言模型中的性别和种族偏见已被广泛研究，但反LGBTQ偏见仍然未得到充分探索，尤其是在英语以外的语言中。现有的基准测试往往无法捕捉文化和语言上的差异，并且依赖于性别表征。本文引入了一个多语言德英基准数据集，用于评估语言模型中的反LGBTQ偏见。该数据集将来自德语区酷儿群体的社区来源刻板印象与WinoQueer的德语翻译版本相结合。研究利用这些数据评估了八个不同规模和架构的语言模型，并探索了通过在社区内容和进步媒体内容上进行微调来缓解偏见的方法。结果表明，语言模型会再现反酷儿刻板印象，且在不同身份和不同模型之间存在差异。翻译数据与社区数据之间的差异凸显了文化适应对于多语言偏见评估的重要性。微调能够减少这些偏见。
tldr: 本文构建了一个融合德语区酷儿社区刻板印象与WinoQueer德语翻译的德英双语基准数据集，评估发现八个语言模型均会再现反LGBTQ刻板印象，且通过在社区内容上进行微调可以有效缓解此类偏见，同时凸显了文化适应在多语言偏见评估中的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a German-English benchmark dataset combining community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a translated WinoQueer to evaluate anti-LGBTQ biases in eight language models, finding that models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes and that fine-tuning on community content can mitigate them, highlighting the importance of cultural adaptation in multilingual bias evaluation.
